name: pix-payment
description: Complete Pix payment flow with QR code generation, copy-paste code, countdown timer, and payment status tracking

pixKey.description: Pix key (CPF, CNPJ, email, phone, or random)

context.whenToUse: For any payment flow targeting Brazilian customers. Pix is the most used payment method in Brazil, accounting for over 40 billion transactions per year.
context.whenNotToUse: For international payments or when Pix is not available as a payment option.
context.accessibility: QR code includes alt text with the Pix copy-paste code. Timer announces remaining time. Payment status changes are announced.
context.culturalNote: Pix is Brazil's instant payment system, launched by the Central Bank in 2020. It operates 24/7, including holidays, and transfers are completed in seconds. It has become the preferred payment method for both online and in-person transactions, surpassing credit cards and boletos.
